title: Government background check on Harrington's neighbours
summary: Brent Freriedman tells of Government background check on Harrington's neighbours, about c. 1980 at Walnut Creek, California, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: because about a year earlier or so, we had been approached, the family, by some like NSA or like CIA or someone that come in and asked a bunch of questions.

plain: Brent Friedman, who grew up near a man named John Harrington in Walnut Creek, California, says that around 1980 his family was approached by people from a government agency, something like the NSA or the CIA, both US intelligence services. He says they came in and asked a lot of questions, which he took as a background check on Harrington's neighbours. If true, it would mean Harrington was being vetted for some kind of secret government work.
